verses.text: Moses was tending the flock of Jethro, his father-in-law and Midian’s priest. He led the flock deep into the wilderness and reached Horeb, God’s mountain. 🐑
Yahweh’s angel appeared to him in a flame of fire coming from a bush. Moses looked—and the bush was burning, but it wasn’t getting used up. 🔥
Moses said, ‘I’ve got to go closer and check out this amazing sight. Why isn’t the bush burning up?’ 👀
When Yahweh saw Moses coming over to look, God called to him from the bush: ‘Moses! Moses!’ He answered, ‘I’m here.’ 🗣️
God said, ‘Don’t come any closer. Take off your sandals, because the ground you’re standing on is holy.’ 🩴
He said, ‘I am the God of your father—the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.’ Moses hid his face because he was afraid to look at God. 🙏
Yahweh said, ‘I’ve seen how badly my people are suffering in Egypt. I’ve heard them crying out under their taskmasters. I know their pain. 💔

‘I’ve come down to rescue them from the Egyptians and bring them out of that land to a good, spacious land, flowing with milk and honey—the land of the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites. 🗺️
‘Their cry has reached me. I’ve also seen how the Egyptians are crushing them. 😢
‘So come on—I’m sending you to Pharaoh. Bring my people, Israel, out of Egypt.’ 📣
Moses said to God, ‘Who am I to go to Pharaoh and bring Israel out of Egypt?’ 😟
God said, ‘I’ll be with you. Here’s your sign that I’m the one sending you: after you bring the people out of Egypt, you’ll worship God on this mountain.’ 🕊️
Moses said to God, ‘When I go to the Israelites and say, “Your ancestors’ God sent me,” they’ll ask, “What’s his name?” What should I tell them?’ ❓
God said to Moses, ‘I AM WHO I AM.’ Then he said, ‘Tell the Israelites: “I AM sent me to you.”’ ✨
God also said to Moses, ‘Tell the Israelites: “Yahweh, your ancestors’ God—the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob—sent me to you.” This is my name forever, remembered through every generation. 📜
‘Go gather Israel’s elders and tell them: “Yahweh, your ancestors’ God—the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob—appeared to me and said, ‘I’ve come to you and seen what’s being done to you in Egypt. 🗣️
“‘I’ve decided to bring you out of Egypt’s suffering and into the land of the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites—a land flowing with milk and honey.’”’ 🗺️

‘They’ll listen to you. Then you and Israel’s elders must go to Egypt’s king and tell him, “Yahweh, God of the Hebrews, met with us. Please let us travel three days into the wilderness to offer sacrifices to Yahweh our God.”’ 🙏
‘I know Egypt’s king won’t let you go—not even under pressure. ⚠️
‘So I’ll reach out and strike Egypt with all the wonders I’ll perform there. After that, he’ll let you go. 🌟
‘I’ll make the Egyptians look favorably on these people. When you leave, you won’t go empty-handed. 🎁

‘Every woman should ask her Egyptian neighbor and any woman staying in her home for silver and gold jewelry and clothing. Put these on your sons and daughters. In this way, you’ll take wealth from Egypt with you.’ 💛
